paragraphs.text: The Fomori-Eldrazi war was a millennia old conflict in the Edge .

In the conflict, the Fomori and the Drix fought an incursion of the Eldrazi through the Chaos Wall . The war was incredibly devastating, bringing all of reality to the brink of destruction. The Fomori were successful, with the Eldrazi being forced out of the Edge.

Although the Eldrazi went into remission, the Fomori disappeared from the Edge in the aftermath of the conflict. Since the end of that age, the Drix have remained consummate Eldrazi hunters, using the Fabric of All Being to identify and assassinate critical Eldrazi potential beings to slow — and hopefully prevent — the return of the great devourers.

As he accessed Jadzi 's mind while the oracle died and traveled back in time, Jace Beleren saw, amid the chaos of the two planes colliding, "formless Eldrazi horrors snaking around the great ships battling them". There is a possibility that the Fomori-Eldrazi war is linked to the formation of the plane of Arcavios .

The Vaar were nearly eradicated in the war. They fled from the Eldrazi into a virtual world, the Hylderhigh . Only a few nodes connecting to the Hylderhigh remain in reality. Only one Vaar being or conduit may remain, named Inevitable-24 .
